_comment: Copy this file to your project root as loop.config.json. Command-line options override these values.
_about_verify: Put each task's own check on its line in TASKS.md ('| verify: ...'); checks of tasks already done are re-run automatically. 'verify' below runs after EVERY task: use it for what must always pass (build, lint). If you put the full test suite here, set stop-on-block to true, because a blocked task's failing tests would make every later task fail.
_about_agent_errors: An agent call that fails without changing any file (quota, network, login) is not charged to the task. After max-agent-errors failures in a row the loop pauses; run it again to resume.
